name: transcribe_audio
description: Transcribe an existing audio recording into text. Use for 'transcribe this recording', 'what's said in this audio', 'meeting notes from this file', or 'turn this voice memo into text'. Accepts a Stash reference or policy-approved local audio path in AAC, FLAC, M4A, MP3, MP4, MPEG, MPGA, OGG, WAV, or WebM. Long files are bounded, split near silence when possible, transcribed sequentially, stitched without rewriting, and saved as a full Stash transcript with a bounded inline excerpt. Pair transcript_stash_ref with stash, canvas, remember, manage_intel, or text_summarizer. For YouTube captions from a video URL, use youtube_transcript. For watching a video, use analyze_video. Do not use convert_file when the user wants words rather than another media format.

source.description: Audio source as stash://space_id/file_id or a policy-approved local file path. Save Internet audio with stash kind=url first.

save_to_stash.description: Save the complete transcript as a durable Stash text artifact. Default true. Long transcripts are forced into Stash even when false so provider output is not discarded.

output_space_id.description: Optional existing Stash space for the transcript.

output_name.description: Optional safe .txt or .md filename for the saved transcript.
